title: SotaComparison 1.0: the recommended protocol against the state of the art
description: A recommended protocol is only interesting next to how the field already makes this cell. This document gathers the leading published protocols for the target cell -- by route (directed differentiation that recapitulates development, forward programming by transcription factors, transdifferentiation, or isolation of the primary/adult cell) -- each with its reported yield, purity and timeline and its citation. It then lines the recommended protocol up against them, lever by lever and overall: where it matches the state of the art, where it differs, and where it does something none of them does. A difference carries only an EXPECTED effect -- a hypothesis with cited support and capped confidence, never a measured improvement: this system's model is uncalibrated and claims no real gain. The standing is one of matches / variant / departs, never 'better' or 'best'.

is_benchmark.description: Whether this is the closest comparator to the recommended protocol -- same cell, same route, most comparable readouts.

dimension.description: A lever or an overall readout: 'M-CSF dose at myeloid', 'differentiation timeline', 'purity at harvest'.

state_of_the_art.description: What the leading protocols do here, with the ref_ids they come from.

difference.description: For differs/novel: what is different, in one line.

expected_effect.description: A hypothesis about what the difference changes -- never a measured result. Absent when the difference is not expected to change an outcome, or when nothing supports a direction.
